signature: The daycare you remember from when you were three, at a child's scale: crayon drawings, a book nook, a fenced playground, a dead goldfish you never had, whispers of every regret, and a plush green dinosaur who brings you juice and, if you follow him long enough, takes you wherever you want to go.

exits.source_quote: the most simple method is to turn around and leave, which will take you to Level 19
exits.label: Turned round and walked back out of the memory
exits.hint: The doorway you came in by is still right behind you, full of light.

exits.method: Follow The Plush Dino for an extended period
exits.source_quote: you can follow him for an extended period, which will take you to the Level you desire to go to
exits.label: Followed the Plush Dino through the playground gate to the level you wanted
exits.hint: If the little green dinosaur finds you, stay close to him.
exits.implemented_as: the gate trigger is created only once the follow is complete; the chosen level is written into the cached edge right before it can fire (as in L906)

notes: SOURCE: appears as a childhood memory of age 2-5, different per viewer, most commonly a preschool or daycare, otherwise a bedroom, classroom or playground; numerous voices whispering regrets and mistakes, nearly impossible to suppress; resurfaced forgotten memories such as dead childhood animals; allergies suppressed; addictive, no harm, provides all materials for survival, no threats, 'enjoys' company; The Plush Dino: rare, sentient, moving, wanders, guides, brings food and water; exits: turn around and leave -> Level 19; follow the Plush Dino for an extended period -> the Level you desire. ADAPTATION: one seeded daycare (wall palette and a seeded extra memory room: bedroom, classroom or washroom) with a fenced playground stands in for 'different for every viewer'; everything is built at a child's scale (~1.4x: 3.9 m ceilings, 2.9 m doors, toddler furniture at adult height); soft afternoon light and room tone are ours (the page states neither); whisper lines are generic and player-neutral; the dead animal is a goldfish; the Plush Dino appears after 1-2.5 minutes, wanders a loop, leaves a juice box and sandwich, and after 150 s of following leads to the playground gate where a picker lists levels (visited first) and the gate opens onto the choice; the arrival doorway behind the player is the 'turn around and leave' exit. QA: the dino is present from the start and the follow takes 6 s.
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Plush Dino (rare, gentle, wanders, guides, brings food and water). The whispering voices are a phenomenon, not an entity. The Children outpost is not staged (no people are shown).
